steps.content:
7:00 a.m., August 23, N.F. 113
FAC Black Ring Blockade Operation Joint Command

The first set of critical strongholds has been successfully captured, and the anti-Mania core base is under rapid construction. As anticipated, we've met with resistance; hordes of Mania Mutants and incited remnants of rioters are relentlessly attacking our front lines.

But exactly as Observer X from Paradeisos predicted, we successfully deceived the enemy with intelligence operations before the battle. They received a falsified stronghold distribution map and walked right into our pre-laid trap.
This provided our spearhead forces with a crucial advantage. Bolstered by soaring morale, we're making steady progress in fortifying our frontlines.
Schorl has assumed communications duties, while Shalom attentively listens to incoming messages.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Is that so... That's wonderful news.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You're too kind. You are the true heroes, spilling blood and sweat on the front lines to face the enemy. My role, as assigned by Paradeisos, is to support you in every way possible.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Well, the core base is now secure, and the entire defense grid has been successfully activated. It's time to focus on the front lines; there's limited scope for intel operations now.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Going forward, the Underground forces will spring into action; that's where the real struggle begins. I have other crucial tasks to attend to as well.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Good luck out there, heroes of Dis.
Communications have been closed. Schorl hovers silently beside her, emitting a flicker of blue light.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: <color=#7683a2>We're operating efficiently. All other departments are in place. Next up—</color>

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: It's time to deal with SHP-13.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Certainly, your assessment is spot-on. Locating <color=#fb9259>him</color> is our foremost priority at this moment.
steps.female_content: Certainly, your assessment is spot-on. Locating <color=#fb9259>her</color> is our foremost priority at this moment.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Either we capitalize on this moment to fully reform him into someone "trustworthy," or we eradicate this latent threat altogether. Paradeisos must locate him before the Underground becomes aware.
steps.female_content: Either we capitalize on this moment to fully reform her into someone "trustworthy," or we eradicate this latent threat altogether. Paradeisos must locate her before the Underground becomes aware.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Neither FAC, MBCC, the 9th Agency, nor even HUSH can directly intervene; the objective would be far too transparent, and the Underground would inevitably detect it. They should remain focused on the front lines—the August Offensive serves as our optimal subterfuge.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: As for the remainder, entrust it to me. I know precisely <color=#fb9259>whom</color> to engage for the task; plans have already been formulated for his retrieval. Consider this my ultimate, flawlessly executed mission.
steps.female_content: As for the remainder, entrust it to me. I know precisely <color=#fb9259>whom</color> to engage for the task; plans have already been formulated for her retrieval. Consider this my ultimate, flawlessly executed mission.

steps.content: ...Unless someone interferes.
Just as this thought crosses her mind, a visitor darkens her doorstep.
Ah, has the grand operation come to a successful close?

Emerging from the shadows behind her, the Garden's Mentor holds a floral sword marred with the remnants of her quarry. She breaches the most stringent security, silently evading all alarms, and now stands before the Hush.
Shalom doesn't turn around, but Schorl is already hovering behind her, entering a state of heightened alert.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Welcome, Mentor. We've located the Undergrounder, adorned with unsettling blooms. Your handiwork, I presume?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Uh-huh, don't mention it—you all owe me more thanks than you could imagine. If it weren't for my <color=#fb9259>"gentle nudge,"</color> that FAC Commander-in-Chief and those junior commanders wouldn't have even made it to the battlefield.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: So, shouldn't the highest honor for this West District Defense Operation go to me?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Absolutely, you're nothing short of remarkable.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Taking on the Underground's most crucial assignment, you've plunged headlong into the fiercest zones of conflict for both sides. After stirring the pot, you subtly redirected the chaos back towards your own client. Ultimately, you've broken the chains that have been choking you for so long.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: It's a delicate balancing act, but you've managed it well—no wonder you've been able to move so freely between Paradeisos and the Underground for years.
Shalom turns to Coquelic, her smile tinged with kindness.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Seeing as you've severed all ties with the Underground... would you consider aligning with me?
Coquelic is taken aback, yet pleasantly surprised.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Really? Is it possible? Would you forgive me, accept us?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Ah, I can't go on pretending any longer.

In the blink of an eye, the crimson floral sword and the obsidian shield clash and recoil. Shalom remains unmoving, while Rahu has already positioned herself before her, deflecting Coquelic's assault with her shield.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Heh, it's this pathetic guard again. You had some spirit last time I saw you; what happened, did my blade snuff out that spirit, turning you into her lapdog?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I still remember vividly what happened to her last lapdog. So what's the deal with that airhead? Dead, or just cried her eyes out?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: And people still buy into your nonsense after seeing that? What, did you brainwash them or something?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: You sure live without a care, settling scores as if it's nothing. Most people wouldn't dare;

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: They'd fear accumulating enemies, endangering those they care about... the steep price of revenge.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: What's your take? Does it not bother you? And what about your Garden?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Hehe... You're talking about the unending chain of hatred, aren't you? When will this cycle of vengeance ever break? Is your point to value those who stand before us now?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: I am the Master of the Garden, the head of Assassin Group. People seeking vengeance flock to me in droves, just as countless others beseech me to exact revenge on their behalf. And you're talking to me about hatred?

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Would you spare me your harassment because I am just and kind? No, the only reason you'd hesitate is the knowledge that crossing my path means certain death.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: This world has never been kind to us just because I tread carefully and abide by the rules. The only things that grant us the freedom to truly live are <color=#fb9259>raw power</color> and the principle of an eye for an eye.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: Shall I teach you this lesson up close and personal?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Hmm, my apologies. With your strength, you've certainly earned the right to act as you wish.

Reaching out, she catches petals falling amidst their fierce clash. These are the Mania flowers, crafted by Coquelic. Shalom appreciates their delicate beauty as she lightly rubs them between her fingers.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Both Paradeisos and the Underground fear your might and madness, dreading the day you'll come to collect their dues. As long as you're alive, neither your Garden nor your Blooms need to worry about being trampled.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If I were you, I'd be more at ease, more reassured—just as you <color=#fb9259>used to be</color>. You've always struck a fine balance between the two.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: If so, why this sudden impatience?

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Both sides are on the brink of war, and yet, you've not only chosen not to sidestep the conflict—you've thrown yourself into it. You accepted a contract from the Underground to challenge the Paradeisos, and now, you're turning their own blade back on them. It's as if you're determined to sever every tie that binds your Garden, come what may.
Her gaze settles on Coquelic, taking in her impossibly youthful face and her eerily pale skin. It's as if time has stood still for her, frozen in some distant past.
Shalom smiles, a knowing glint in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Your extraordinary strength has been traded for your <color=#fb9259>life</color>, hasn't it? Just how many days do you have left, Mentor?
The atmosphere grows suddenly tense.
Coquelic fixes her eyes on the Hush of Paradeisos. After a moment that feels like an eternity, she unsheathes her sword—this time, all levity has vanished.

steps.speaker: Coquelic
steps.content: ...Are you wishing for my death? How uncouth. I'll have you know, my days are numbered higher than yours!

steps.speaker: Shalom
steps.content: Just a question—is it that I hit the nail on the head?
Shalom laughs. Before she can even finish speaking, that white figure surges forward, crashing forcefully into Rahu's shield.
